project_context.name: CareerOS
project_context.type: SaaS Platform (French Career Decision & Guidance GPS)
project_context.description: Incremental UX enhancement layer acting as a Career GPS (Où suis-je ? Qu'ai-je complété ? Quelle est ma prochaine étape ?)

accent_tokens.neutral_secondary: bg-slate-800 text-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-700 (dark) / bg-slate-100 text-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-200 (light)
accent_tokens.ghost: text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-800/50 (dark) / text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-100 (light)

JourneyBar.purpose: Step trail navigation showing Career Memory -> Radar -> Pack -> Entrevue -> Suivi + Global progress (X/6 terminées)

tailwind_classes.container: w-full border-b border-slate-800/60 bg-slate-900/50 backdrop-blur-md px-4 py-3 flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3 text-sm
tailwind_classes.step_item: flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer transition-colors duration-150
tailwind_classes.progress_badge: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-indigo-500/10 text-indigo-400 border border-indigo-500/20

JourneyBar.mobile_behavior: Horizontal scrolling pill bar or compact select box on screens < 768px

NextStepBanner.purpose: Permanent 'Que faire ensuite ?' header/banner guiding the member to their single next recommended action

tailwind_classes.container: relative overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-indigo-500/30 bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-950/40 via-slate-900/60 to-slate-900/40 p-4 md:p-5 flex flex-col md:flex-row items-start md:items-center justify-between gap-4 shadow-sm
tailwind_classes.title: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-indigo-400 flex items-center gap-1.5
tailwind_classes.primary_cta: inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white hover:bg-indigo-500 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-400 focus:ring-offset-2 transition-colors duration-150 shadow-md whitespace-nowrap

NextStepBanner.rule: MUST contain exactly ONE primary CTA button matching the current recommended milestone

InfoTip.purpose: Contextual help popover / tooltip with a small 'i' icon for important concepts (IPS, A/B/C, Analyse approfondie, Pack, Career Memory, etc.)

tailwind_classes.trigger: inline-flex items-center justify-center w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-slate-800 hover:bg-indigo-900/50 text-slate-400 hover:text-indigo-400 text-xs font-bold transition-colors ml-1 cursor-help border border-slate-700/60
tailwind_classes.content: max-w-xs rounded-lg border border-slate-800 bg-slate-900 p-3 text-xs text-slate-300 shadow-xl backdrop-blur-md z-50 animate-in fade-in-0 zoom-in-95

GuidedTourModal.purpose: First startup guided onboarding tour (Max 5 steps: Career Memory, Radar, Pack, Préparation d'entrevue, Suivi)
GuidedTourModal.relaunch: Available anytime from the Aide top menu button

tailwind_classes.overlay: fixed inset-0 bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-sm z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4
tailwind_classes.dialog: w-full max-w-lg rounded-2xl border border-slate-800 bg-slate-900 p-6 shadow-2xl space-y-4

AideMenuAndModeToggle.purpose: Aide dropdown menu enabling user to relaunch Guided Tour and toggle between Mode Débutant (guides visible) and Mode Expert (guides hidden)

tailwind_classes.menu_container: rounded-lg border border-slate-800 bg-slate-900 p-2 text-sm text-slate-200 shadow-lg z-50
tailwind_classes.mode_switch: flex items-center justify-between p-2 rounded-md hover:bg-slate-800 cursor-pointer

ActionHierarchyRules.overflow_rule: Group remaining actions in a dropdown button labeled 'Plus'
ActionHierarchyRules.primary_button_style: bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white font-medium px-4 py-2 rounded-lg shadow-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500/40
ActionHierarchyRules.secondary_button_style: bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 font-medium px-3.5 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-700/80
ActionHierarchyRules.ghost_button_style: text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-800/60 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg

testing_requirements.data_testid_rule: All interactive elements, buttons, step indicators, tooltips, tour controls, and menu triggers MUST include kebab-case data-testid attributes.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not redesign existing pages or change color palettes outside the specified Indigo/Slate/Emerald/Rose theme.
Ensure all new UX elements (JourneyBar, NextStep Banner, InfoTip, GuidedTour, Action Hierarchy) work smoothly in both dark (#0b0d14) and light modes.
Always set explicit hover and focus text colors to maintain high contrast ratio.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes for E2E testing.
Use Lucide-React icons and React components (.js / .jsx format).
